findings.detail: Rechecked all 80 source/target blocks. Esteban's question is now a complete separate greeting with appropriate speaker/narration. The surname has consistent accepted form Ферстаппен; the old, conflicting lexical entry in the book-wide glossary must be reconciled by the orchestrator, not by reverting source-faithful chapter prose.

source_anchor.quote: “What’s up, Verstappen?” Esteban greets Max with a wide grin.

translation_anchor.quote: «Как дела, Ферстаппен?» — приветствует Макса Эстебан, широко улыбаясь.
